documents.text:
Annals of a Small Port

Contents

BOOK I. OF THE HARBOUR. CHAPTER I. OF THE TIDES. CHAPTER II. OF THE GULLS. BOOK II. OF THE TOWN. CHAPTER I. OF THE MARKET.

These annals were kept by the harbour office and copied fair each winter.

BOOK I. OF THE HARBOUR.

CHAPTER I. OF THE TIDES.

The spring tides reached the chapel steps twice in the year of the flood.

CHAPTER II. OF THE GULLS.

The gulls nested on the old pier until the lamp was moved.

BOOK II. OF THE TOWN.

CHAPTER I. OF THE MARKET.

The fish market opened at first light and closed when the tide turned.

documents.name: logbook
documents.text:
Tuesday. The mail boat waited an hour for the pilot.

Chapter and verse of the harbour rules were read aloud to the crew.

Thursday. A schooner from the north put in for water.
